contexts.text: Let them take their portion () = that they were given into their Power. Explained.
Is there any portion and inheritance for us in our father's house? () = the first state of their separation from the good signified by Laban... Is there any portion? = is there any conjunction.
He bought the portion of the field () = the appropriation of good from that truth.
He lifted up portions from his faces to them () = goods applied to everyone from mercy; (for) the portions of foods = goods.
He multiplied Benjamin's portion above the portions of them all () = good for the medium above the goods for the truths in the Natural. Portions = goods.
I give thee one portion above thy brethren () = that the truth of the Intellectual and the good of the Voluntary should have more in the Church. Explained. AC 6306. AC 6306:6.
It shall be to thee for a portion () = communication with those who are in truths Divine... To be for a portion = communication. Explained.
All things are full of God, and each one takes his portion from that fulness.
In common civility mutual love is shown externally by giving better portions...
Jehovah shall make Judah... His portion upon the land of holiness ().
Jehovah is the portion of your part ().
